TIEBA_DIY_CARD_TIMES_TWO.description: Whenever any creature applies a [gold]Power[/gold], double the amount applied.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_MOVING_AROUND.title: Moving Around
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_IF_THERE_IS_TOMORROW.desc:
Add {Cards:diff()} upgraded [gold]Wisps[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold],
then apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
[gold]On Exhaust[/gold]: Osty dies.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_INTO_THE_UNDERWORLD_TOGET: Apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to an enemy. Apply {SelfDoom} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_DEJA_VU.title: Deja Vu
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_DEJA_VU.description: While this card is in your Hand, cards you play have a [blue]{Chance}%[/blue] chance to be negated.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_LIGHT_COPPER.title: Light Copper
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_TRANCE.title: Trance
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_TRANCE.description: When drawn, [gold]Transform[/gold] all of your Curses and Status cards except itself.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_EIGHT_INCH_NAIL.title: Eight-Inch Nail
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_EIGHT_INCH_NAIL.descripti: Whenever you draw a card, add this card to your Hand.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_ORAL_FIBROSIS.title: Oral Fibrosis
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_ORAL_FIBROSIS.description: While this card is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], you cannot play cards that cost {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_IRON_WAVE_PRO.title: Iron Wave Pro
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_IRON_WAVE_PRO.description: Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold] X times. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage X times.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_ATROCITY.title: Atrocity
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_ATROCITY.description: At the start of your turn, apply {AtrocityPower:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_WORLD_OF_PILLARS.title: Creation of Pillar
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_WORLD_OF_PILLARS.descript: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], add {Cards:diff()} cards to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_HOT_START.title: Hot Start
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_HOT_START.description: Whenever you [gold]Channel[/gold] an Orb, trigger its passive ability {HotStartPower:diff()} times.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_ELECTRONIC_SHEEP.title: Electronic Sheep
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_ELECTRONIC_SHEEP.descript: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] cards you skipped this run and add it to your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It can be played for free this turn.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_MURAMASA.title: Muramasa
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_MURAMASA.description:
Deal {Damage} damage.
[gold]Fatal[/gold]: Gain a random Curse.
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_RECURSION.title: Recursion
TIEBA_DIY_CARD_RECURSION.description:
[gold]Evoke[/gold] your rightmost Orb.
Then [gold]Channel[/gold] an Orb that was just [gold]Evoked[/gold].
